instruction: Befriend on Venmo anyone I have received money from this month.
notes: Single-app task (venmo). Flow: get passwords -> venmo login -> list received transactions since the start of the month (direction=received, min_created_at=2023-05-01T00:00:00; paginate if needed) -> add_friend for each distinct sender not already a friend -> complete_task without an answer. The senders are unknown before the lookup, so they are modeled as placeholder entities sender-1/sender-2 (two, matching the 6-call reference solution) whose emails become usable only after (transactions-listed) is asserted by venmo-show-transactions; the number of placeholder senders should be adjusted to the actual number of distinct non-friend senders at runtime. supervisor-complete-task takes the befriended senders as non-API record parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal (both senders are friends) without quantifiers. Goal demands only new venmo.Friendship records for those senders and no other changes.
